title: Import a DWG/DXF file into a new PCB document
summary: Creates a new PCB document, runs the built-in PCB:Import process on it for an AutoCAD DWG/DXF file (the user confirms AD's import dialog), counts the primitives added and saves the board as a PcbDoc.
phrasings: import an AutoCAD drawing into a board
load a DXF outline into a new PcbDoc
create and save a new PCB document from code

commands.name: ImportDwg
commands.description: Import a DWG/DXF file into a new PCB document and save it
commands.params: File=<.dwg or .dxf path, required>|Out=<folder or .PcbDoc path> (default temp folder, named after File)|Overwrite=true (optional)|Silent=false (optional, default true: passes Silent=True|TestMode=True, which do not suppress the import dialog)
